accepted_statistical_rules: Two fixed primary comparisons; each person averages three seeds after equal weighting of eligible record-local blocks.
Undefined fixed-support model/primary is reported undefined; its internal p=1 reserves the two-test Holm family without changing the other comparison.
One FP32 sensitivity-diagnostic failure cannot invalidate valid FP64 primary scores; the diagnostic failure remains visible.
Exact sign enumeration is conditional on independent people and sign symmetry/exchangeability, not unconditional causal or distribution-free evidence.
Shared person bootstrap draws and the prespecified Bonferroni family95 approximate percentile intervals are retained.

source_review.judgment: Distinct collection and stimulus-language evidence; complete participant and original-waveform cross-corpus identity exclusion remains unavailable.

Author preprint Table1 and Section2.1: SparrKULee Dutch/Flemish, Broderick English, DTU Danish.
Section2.4: professionally recorded male/female Danish fictional stories.
